what: APA Corporation produces oil and gas. Its main operations are in the Permian basin, Egypt's Western Desert, and the North Sea, and it has a large discovery offshore Suriname being developed with TotalEnergies.
customers: Refiners and crude buyers in the United States, Egypt and Europe.
money: Western Desert oil and gas under production sharing contracts
moat: A long-established Egyptian position with low-cost barrels and production sharing terms, plus a stake in one of the largest recent offshore oil discoveries.
risks: Egyptian operations carry political and payment risk
North Sea production is declining and UK taxes on it are high
Debt of about $3.3 billion against almost no cash
opportunities: The Suriname development adds substantial production later this decade
A dividend yield around 2% with consistent buybacks
watch: Suriname project progress and Egyptian production volumes.
